Name: Grandpa's Bed - Better Introduction for Content Patcher
Author: arachnida
Description:
I am always starting new save files, and, to add a little more depth to my farmers, I usually don't skip the intro.
But that bed always gave me the creeps... So unworthy of my dear grandpa...

This is an edit of the original introduction to suit better my views of the inside of the farmhouse at the time of grandpa's resting.
It also edits the monitors from Joja, which was something that always struck a nerve with me... Why are they so huge!?

I'll provide both Content Patcher and XNB file on the downloads tab.

For the Content Patcher to work, you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and an updated [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]. 
For the XNB file to work, you need to replace the original file under [i][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#efefef]Stardew Valley [/color][color=#999999]>[/color][color=#efefef] Content [/color][color=#999999]>[/color][color=#efefef] Minigames [/color][color=#999999]>[/color][color=#efefef] jojacorps.xnb
[/color][/font][/i]
Thanks, I hope you like it!
